facts.statement: Robbie the Robgoblin set up a competing summer camp across the lake; both camps have quests, counselors, rewards and Marketplace and Coin Shop items.
facts.quote: Robbie the Robgoblin has set up a competing camp across the lake.

article_summaries.title: Summer Camp All Summer Long
article_summaries.summary: A Free Realms news post announcing the summer Community Team event season: Chatty's summer camp in Greenwood Forest (reached by a newly activated Warpstone) and Robbie the Robgoblin's rival camp across the lake, with weekly themed events through Labor Day. It gives the expected in-game event schedule and how to join events via the Game Guide calendar.
